title: Ukanushaji wa Maneno (Theme 11: Ushuru)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child negates -ki- with -sipo- (usiposoma), -nge- with -singe- (asingekuja) and -ngali- with -singali-.
steps: Negate the result too if needed.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Usiposoma" and the negative of "Angekuja".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___." Kwa nini "Usikisoma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika ukanushaji wa masharti, ki- hubadilika kuwa -sipo-: Ukisoma, Usiposoma.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno "Akija" likikanushwa huwa ___." Kwa nini "Hakija" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___." Kwa nini "Usisome" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Usisome ni amri ya kutosoma. Sharti hasi la Ukisoma ni Usiposoma.
